title: 工業力学Ⅰ(再履修クラス)(夏期集中講義)
subtitle: Engineering Mechanics I
keywords: Force 2.Composition and decomposition of force 3.Moment of force 4.Equilibrium of forces 5.Center of gravity
educationalGoal: Calculate the forces which act on the parts. Get abilities to apply to mechanical design.
advice: Engineering Mechanics is the basis for all mechanical designs. We will cover the following topics: (1) Force (2) Composition and decomposition of force (3) Moment of force (4) Equilibrium of forces (5) Center of gravity Students will be aided in understanding and applying these five concepts through exercises.
requiredKnowledge: Must have a good understanding of high school level math and physics

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain forces using SI units
Be able to understand the concept of force and compose/decompose forces.
Be able to understand the concept of moment and calculate the moment force
Be able to find the equilibrium of force and calculate it.
Be able to understand the concept of center of gravity and calculate it.
Be able to determine the stability of an object

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Force can be explained in an arbitrary coordinate system. (2) The direction of force and different line actions can be obtained. (3) Force moment can be calculated in 3D. (4) The lines of force action on actual parts can be explained. (5) The center of gravity of actual parts can be calculated. (6) The stability of actual parts can be calculated.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Force can be explained in the SI unit coordinate system. (2) The direction of force and line actions can be obtained. (3) Force moment can be calculated in 2D. (4) The lines of force action on simple parts can be explained. (5) The center of gravity of simple parts can be calculated. (6) The stability of simple parts can be calculated.
